subtheme: Records and attributes (one entity per passage)
what_was_done: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/calibration/spec.md, tasks/calibration/dev.json and the checker helpers in lab/core.py (norm, answer_text, last_number, run_check).
Wrote 21 single-mode tasks g1-01..g1-21 with a Python builder script using the verbatim prompt convention, max_tokens 80, no system field and the spec's checker patterns.
Did not run the model on these tasks and did not read other generators' files.

balance.note: 21 is odd, so an exact half split is impossible; the split is 11/10.

answer_verification: Numeric answers computed in the builder script and asserted: 48-13=35 (g1-09), 40+40*2=120 (g1-13), 50-18-20=12 (g1-21); naive wrong value 14*3=42 used as the negative of g1-16.
Builder asserts each name/word answer appears verbatim in its passage, each passage is 25-60 words, and neither passage nor question contains the word INSUFFICIENT.
Each task reread for airtightness: unanswerable items give no value for the asked attribute by lookup, arithmetic or elimination; answerable items have exactly one supported value.
not_done: No baseline pilot (held-out by instruction), so difficulty labels are estimates from the spec's guidance, not measured.
